en.headline: Wang Xinyu advances at Hong Kong Tennis Open after straight-sets win
en.dek: The sixth seed defeated wild-card Adithya Karunaratne 6-1, 6-1 in the first round at Victoria Park on Monday.
body: Sixth-seeded Wang Xinyu of China advanced to the second round of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open after defeating Hong Kong wild-card Adithya Karunaratne 6-1, 6-1 on Monday.
The match lasted about 63 minutes on the outdoor hard courts at Victoria Park. Wang, ranked around 38th, broke Karunaratne's serve multiple times in a dominant display.
Other first-round results included Mary Stoiana defeating Venus Williams 6-2, 6-3, and Maria Sakkari advancing past Carol Young Suh Lee. The WTA 250 event runs through November 8.
The main draw opened earlier this week, with play continuing on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 王欣瑜保誠香港網球公開賽首輪直落兩盤晉級
zh.dek: 六號種子周一在維多利亞公園以6-1、6-1擊敗香港外卡卡魯納拉特納，晉級次輪。
body: 中國六號種子王欣瑜在保誠香港網球公開賽首輪以6-1、6-1直落兩盤擊敗香港外卡卡魯納拉特納，晉級次輪。
比賽在維多利亞公園室外硬地進行，耗時約63分鐘。排名約38的王欣瑜多次破發，表現強勢。
其他首輪結果包括斯托亞納以6-2、6-3擊敗大威廉姆斯，以及薩卡里擊敗李。這項WTA 250賽事將進行至11月8日。
正賽本周早些時候開打，周二繼續進行。
